residual.deeperDefectEvidence: The original Stage 2I.2 head has no indeterminate-direction abstention and answers NOT_PERSISTENT on a flat or alternating series — its own STABLE family is labelled exactly that. Stage 2I.3 added `dominantSign === 0 || |slope| < .003 || support < .28 -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`, so the inherited ALTERNATING_INTERRUPTION family, a pure square wave, abstains instead of answering.
residual.remediationWouldRequire: Changing an abstention gate in a frozen head, which is an Oracle algorithm redesign and is out of scope for this stage.

note: These heads remain label-only. Diagnostic quality is measured against the best trivial classifier; no Prime-relative action utility is fabricated.
